faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about JetSet Travel services. Corporate travel, flight booking, visa assistance, pricing, and how our IATA-accredited agency works.

booking.q1: How do I request a travel quote?
booking.a1: Contact us via our website form, WhatsApp (+357 99 478 073), or email (info@jetset.com.cy). Tell us your destination, dates, number of travelers, and preferences. We typically respond with options within 24 hours.
booking.q2: What services does JetSet Travel offer?
booking.a2: We provide corporate travel management, luxury leisure travel planning, flight and hotel bookings, visa assistance, private transfers, and 24/7 travel disruption support.
booking.a3: Yes. We manage group travel for corporate events, team retreats, and large family trips. We handle logistics, coordinated bookings, and negotiate group rates.
booking.a4: Absolutely. We have access to real-time availability and can arrange urgent travel. Contact us via WhatsApp for the fastest response.

corporate.q1: How does your corporate travel management work?
corporate.a1: We assign a dedicated account manager to your company. They handle all bookings, ensure policy compliance, provide clean invoicing for finance teams, and offer 24/7 disruption support.
corporate.a2: Yes. We provide detailed, finance-ready invoices aligned with corporate compliance requirements. Monthly statements and reporting are available for corporate accounts.
corporate.q3: What happens if there's a travel disruption?
corporate.a3: Our 24/7 support team handles rebooking, rerouting, and real-time updates via WhatsApp. We manage the disruption so your team can focus on their work.

payments.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
payments.a1: We accept bank transfers and major credit/debit cards. Payment terms for corporate accounts can be arranged.
payments.a2: Cancellation terms vary depending on the supplier (airline, hotel, etc.). We always communicate specific terms before confirming any booking. Some bookings are non-refundable — we will make this clear upfront.
payments.a3: Travel insurance is not included but strongly recommended. We can help you find appropriate coverage for your trip.

visa.q1: What visa services do you provide?
visa.a1: We provide document checklists, application guidance, and coordination support for business and tourist visas to most countries.
visa.a2: No. Visa approval is at the discretion of the issuing authority. We maximize your chances by ensuring complete and accurate applications.
visa.q3: How long does visa processing take?
visa.a3: Processing times vary widely by country, visa type and season — from a few days for some e-visas to several weeks where an interview or biometrics appointment is needed (Schengen: normally 15 calendar days, up to 45). We recommend starting at least 6–8 weeks before travel, and earlier at busy times.

about.a1: Yes. We are an IATA-accredited travel agent (accreditation number 14200130) and hold Cyprus tourism licence no. 7775 from the Deputy Ministry of Tourism. This means we can issue airline tickets directly on participating airlines.
about.a2: 26A Agapinoros, 8049 Paphos, Cyprus. Office hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 09:00–13:00 & 15:00–18:30. Wednesday & Saturday: 09:00–13:00. Sunday: Closed.
about.q3: Can I reach you outside office hours?
about.a3: Yes. Our WhatsApp support (+357 99 478 073) is available 24/7 for existing bookings and urgent inquiries. Average response time is under 2 hours.
about.q4: What is the best travel agency in Paphos, Cyprus?
about.a4: That depends on what you need. For corporate, luxury and visa travel, JetSet Travel is a long-established option: founded in Paphos in 2006, IATA-accredited (14200130), holding Cyprus tourism licence 7775, serving 520+ clients with a 98% satisfaction rate, and offering service in English, Russian and Greek.
about.a5: Yes. JetSet Travel works in English, Russian and Greek. Our Russian-speaking team can assist with all travel services including corporate travel, flight bookings, hotel reservations, visa applications, and luxury travel planning.
about.q6: How long has JetSet Travel been in business?
about.a6: JetSet Travel was founded in 2006 by Nontari Kalaitsidis and Maro Kokkinou. We have been operating continuously for over 20 years from our office at 26A Agapinoros Street in Paphos, Cyprus.
about.q7: What are the top travel agencies in Cyprus?
about.a7: Cyprus has many licensed travel agencies, concentrated in Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca and Paphos — every travel agency operating in Cyprus must be licensed by the Deputy Ministry of Tourism. JetSet Travel, founded in Paphos in 2006, also holds IATA accreditation (14200130), serves 520+ clients with a 98% satisfaction rate, and offers service in English, Russian and Greek.
about.q8: Why use a travel agent in Cyprus instead of booking online?
about.a8: An IATA-accredited agent like JetSet Travel issues airline tickets directly, gives you one person to deal with for flights, hotels, visas and transfers, and handles rebooking and rerouting for you when plans change — including 24/7 WhatsApp support. For corporate clients, we also apply your travel policy and provide consolidated, finance-ready invoicing.
about.q9: Which travel agency in Cyprus serves Russian-speaking clients?
about.a9: JetSet Travel Cyprus offers full bilingual service in English and Russian (русскоязычное обслуживание) across all services — corporate travel, flight and hotel bookings, visa applications, and luxury travel planning. The agency operates from Paphos and serves Russian-speaking residents and visitors across Cyprus, including Limassol, Nicosia, and Larnaca.

From Schengen and UK visas to US, UAE, and Russian applications — our experienced team handles document preparation, embassy coordination, and status tracking so you can travel with confidence.
visaPage.heroImageAlt: Visa application documents and passport for travel services
visaPage.introP1: Since 2006, JetSet Travel has helped hundreds of travellers based in Paphos and across Cyprus navigate the visa application process. As an IATA-accredited travel agency (accreditation 14200130) with Cyprus tourism licence 7775, we bring two decades of experience to every visa case — from straightforward tourist applications to complex multi-entry business visas.
visaPage.introP2: We follow embassy, consulate and visa-centre requirements closely to stay current on changing rules, processing times and document standards. Whether you need a Schengen visa for a European business trip or a US B1/B2 visa for a conference, our team makes sure your application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
visaPage.visaTypesSubtitle: We handle applications for all major visa categories. Here are the destinations most frequently requested by our clients in Cyprus.
visaPage.schengenVisaDesc: Non-EU nationals living in Cyprus need a Schengen visa to visit the 29 Schengen countries (Cypriot and other EU citizens do not). We assist with short-stay (type C) tourist and business visas, including business invitation letters, travel itineraries and travel medical insurance with at least €30,000 cover. Applications are lodged with the relevant embassy or its visa application centre, most of which are in Nicosia. Consulates normally decide within 15 calendar days of a complete application; this can be extended to 45 days. You can apply up to 6 months, and no later than 15 days, before travel.
visaPage.ukVisaDesc: Whether you need a UK visa depends on your nationality. Cypriot and other EU citizens do not need a visa for visits but must get an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA, currently £20) before travelling; many other nationalities need a Standard Visitor visa. We assist with Standard Visitor visas for tourism, business meetings and short courses, and with longer-term categories — the online UKVI application, the biometrics appointment, and documents such as financial evidence and accommodation details. UKVI usually decides visitor visas within 3 weeks.
visaPage.usVisaDesc: US visa applications require careful preparation, including DS-160 form completion and consular interview scheduling. We assist with B1 (business) and B2 (tourist) visa categories, helping you compile the required documentation — financial statements, employment verification, travel purpose evidence, and ties to your home country. We also provide interview preparation guidance. Typical processing: 3–6 weeks.
visaPage.uaeVisaDesc: Cypriot and most other EU citizens do not need a visa in advance: they receive a free visit visa on arrival for up to 90 days within 180 days. For nationalities that need a visa before travelling, we help arrange UAE tourist visas (30 or 60 days, issued through a UAE-licensed hotel, tour operator or airline), the five-year multiple-entry tourist visa, business visit visas and transit visas. Processing usually takes a few working days.
visaPage.russiaVisaDesc: Citizens of Cyprus and many other countries can apply online for Russia's unified e-visa: no invitation is needed, it allows one entry and a stay of up to 30 days, and decisions usually take about 4 days. Longer or multiple-entry trips need a regular visa, which requires an invitation (a tourist voucher from a registered Russian tour operator or a business invitation). We help obtain the invitation, complete the application and book your appointment at the Russian Embassy in Nicosia or a visa centre. Regular visas typically take 4–10 working days. There are no direct flights between Cyprus and Russia.
visaPage.destSubtitle: Indicative processing times for travellers who need a visa. Requirements depend on nationality: Cypriot and other EU citizens need only an online authorisation for the UK (ETA), Canada (eTA) and Australia (eVisitor), get a visa on arrival in the UAE, and need no visa for short stays in Japan or (until 31 December 2026) China. They still need a visa for the United States.
visaPage.uaeTime: A few working days (visa on arrival for EU citizens)
visaPage.howSubtitle: A clear five-step process from initial enquiry to approved visa. We guide you at every stage.
visaPage.step1Desc: Contact us with your destination, nationality, and travel dates. We assess your visa requirements and advise on the best application strategy — at no charge.
visaPage.step2Desc: We send you a personalised checklist of every document required for your specific visa category, nationality, and travel purpose. No guesswork.
visaPage.step3Desc: Our team reviews all your documents for completeness and accuracy, fills out application forms on your behalf, and flags any potential issues before submission.
visaPage.step4Desc: We book your appointment at the embassy, consulate or visa centre, or submit e-visa applications online, and handle any requests for further documents. Where fingerprints are needed, as for Schengen visas, you attend the appointment in person.
visaPage.step5Desc: We monitor your application status and keep you updated at every stage. Once approved, we coordinate visa collection and confirm you are ready to travel.

visaPage.faqSubtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our visa assistance services.
visaPage.faq1Q: How long does a Schengen visa take from Cyprus?
visaPage.faq1A: Schengen consulates normally decide within 15 calendar days of receiving a complete application, but this can be extended to up to 45 days in individual cases. Appointment slots fill up in spring and summer, so we recommend applying 6–8 weeks before travel; you can apply up to 6 months ahead. We check your file before submission to reduce the risk of delays caused by missing documents.
visaPage.faq2Q: What documents do I need for a business visa?
visaPage.faq2A: Business visa requirements vary by destination, but generally include: a valid passport, recent photographs, a formal invitation letter from the host company, proof of employment or business registration, bank statements covering the last 3–6 months, travel insurance, and flight and hotel reservations. During your free consultation, we provide a detailed checklist specific to your destination and nationality.
visaPage.faq3Q: Do you handle visa applications for groups?
visaPage.faq3A: Yes. We regularly process group visa applications for corporate delegations, conference attendees, and tour groups. Group applications benefit from coordinated submission, consistent documentation standards, and a single point of contact. We manage all logistics including group appointment scheduling at embassies and visa centres.
visaPage.faq4Q: Can you help with urgent or express visa processing?
visaPage.faq4A: Some embassies and visa centres offer priority appointments or express processing for an extra fee, and some e-visas are issued within days. Availability changes often, so contact us with your travel date and we will advise on the fastest option available for your nationality and destination.
visaPage.faq5Q: How much do your visa services cost?
visaPage.faq5A: Our service fee depends on the visa type, destination, and complexity of your application. We provide a clear quote during your free initial consultation — no hidden charges. The fee covers document review, application preparation, submission coordination, and status tracking. Embassy and visa centre fees are charged separately and paid directly to the issuing authority.
visaPage.disclaimer: JetSet Travel Cyprus assists with visa application preparation and submission. Final visa decisions are made solely by the respective embassy or consulate. We do not guarantee visa approval. Processing times are estimates and may vary based on embassy workload, seasonality, and individual circumstances.

cruisesPage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about booking a cruise with JetSet Travel.
cruisesPage.faq1Q: How far in advance should I book a cruise?
cruisesPage.faq1A: We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead for the best cabin selection and early-bird pricing, though last-minute deals are sometimes available. For world cruises or new ship launches, booking 12–18 months ahead is advisable.
cruisesPage.faq2Q: What is included in a cruise fare?
cruisesPage.faq2A: Most cruise fares include your cabin, all meals at main restaurants, entertainment, and use of ship facilities. Drinks, specialty dining, shore excursions, and gratuities are typically extra — though luxury lines like Regent and Viking include most or all of these.
cruisesPage.faq3Q: Can you book flights from Cyprus to any cruise departure port?
cruisesPage.faq3A: Absolutely. As an IATA-accredited agent, we book flights worldwide. We'll coordinate your flights with your cruise schedule so everything connects seamlessly.
cruisesPage.faq4Q: What is the difference between cabin types?
cruisesPage.faq4A: Inside cabins are the most affordable with no window. Ocean view cabins have a porthole or window. Balcony cabins give you a private outdoor space. Suites offer the most space with premium amenities and butler service on some lines.
cruisesPage.faq5Q: Do I need a visa for cruise ports?
cruisesPage.faq5A: Visa requirements depend on your nationality and ports of call. We check all requirements as part of your booking and provide visa assistance through our dedicated visa services team.
cruisesPage.faq6A: Travel insurance is not included in cruise fares but is strongly recommended. We can help you find appropriate coverage for your cruise, including trip cancellation and medical coverage.
cruisesPage.faq7Q: Can JetSet arrange pre and post cruise hotel stays?
cruisesPage.faq7A: Yes. We regularly arrange pre-cruise and post-cruise hotel stays, airport transfers, and city tours at departure and arrival ports worldwide.
cruisesPage.faq8Q: What are the best cruises for families with children?
cruisesPage.faq8A: Royal Caribbean and Disney Cruise Line are the top family choices, offering extensive kids' programmes, waterparks, and family-friendly entertainment. MSC, Carnival, and NCL are also excellent for families.
cruisesPage.faq9Q: What is the best time to cruise the Mediterranean / Caribbean / Alaska?
cruisesPage.faq9A: Mediterranean: April–November. Caribbean: year-round, peak November–April. Alaska: May–September. We can help you find the ideal timing for any destination.
cruisesPage.faq10Q: Can you arrange group or corporate cruise bookings?
cruisesPage.faq10A: Yes. We handle group bookings of any size, including corporate incentive trips, conferences at sea, and family celebrations. Group rates and perks are often available for 8+ cabins.
cruisesPage.faq11A: World cruises usually last about 100 to 180 nights and visit dozens of ports across several continents. You can book the full voyage or a segment. Full voyages on mainstream lines such as MSC and Costa start from roughly EUR 18,000 per person.
cruisesPage.faq12Q: What are the newest ships sailing in 2026?
cruisesPage.faq12A: Major 2026 debuts include Royal Caribbean's Legend of the Seas (joint-largest cruise ship in the world), Norwegian Luna, Disney Adventure (from Singapore), Four Seasons I, Explora III, MSC World Asia, Viking Libra (described by Viking as the first hydrogen-powered cruise ship) and Regent's Seven Seas Prestige. Ask us about availability.

corporateCyprusPage.faqSubtitle: Common questions from businesses considering managed corporate travel.
corporateCyprusPage.faq1Q: How much does corporate travel management cost?
corporateCyprusPage.faq1A: Our fee structure adapts to your volume — from per-transaction fees for smaller companies to monthly management fees for larger ones. We quote fees upfront so you can compare the total cost.
corporateCyprusPage.faq2A: Yes. We provide consolidated monthly invoicing with detailed trip breakdowns, suitable for corporate accounting and VAT compliance. Individual trip invoices are also available on request.
corporateCyprusPage.faq3Q: Can you manage travel for teams of 50+ people?
corporateCyprusPage.faq3A: Absolutely. We manage group travel for conferences, retreats, and project teams regularly. Our systems handle bulk bookings, room blocks, and multi-leg itineraries for groups of any size.
corporateCyprusPage.faq4Q: Do you handle visa requirements for business travel?
corporateCyprusPage.faq4A: Yes. We provide full visa coordination including document checklists, application preparation, and embassy appointment scheduling for all business visa types — Schengen, UK, US, and more.
corporateCyprusPage.faq5Q: What happens if a flight is cancelled?
corporateCyprusPage.faq5A: Our 24/7 disruption support kicks in immediately. We proactively monitor all active bookings and begin rebooking before you even call. Alternative flights, hotels, and ground transport are arranged in real time.

flightsCyprusPage.iataTitle: Why Book Flights Through an IATA Agent
flightsCyprusPage.iataSubtitle: Direct ticketing, more options, and support from a licensed, IATA-accredited agency.
flightsCyprusPage.iataP1: As an IATA-accredited travel agent (code 14200130), JetSet Travel issues airline tickets directly through the Sabre and Galileo (Travelport) global distribution systems, with Farelogix for airlines' NDC offers. That gives us real-time access to most scheduled airlines' fares and availability, and lets us combine airlines, manage changes and handle special requests in one place.
flightsCyprusPage.iataP2: IATA accreditation means we meet IATA's financial and professional criteria and are authorised to issue tickets directly on participating airlines. It is not insurance against an airline going out of business — ask us about travel insurance that covers airline failure. Combined with our 24/7 support, you have one accountable team for every booking.
flightsCyprusPage.iata1Desc: Real-time fares and availability for most scheduled airlines, booked and ticketed by us.
flightsCyprusPage.iata2Desc: We meet IATA's financial and professional standards and issue tickets directly on participating airlines.
flightsCyprusPage.iata3Desc: Corporate fares where airlines offer them, plus flexible fare options for business travellers.
flightsCyprusPage.iata4Desc: Flight cancelled? We rebook you before the queue forms — any time, any day.
flightsCyprusPage.pfoP1: Paphos International Airport connects you to major European cities with direct flights year-round. During summer, seasonal routes expand to cover popular holiday destinations.
flightsCyprusPage.pfoP2: As Paphos-based agents, we know PFO schedules intimately and can advise on the best routing for any destination.
flightsCyprusPage.lcaP1: Larnaca International Airport is Cyprus's main and busiest airport. Together, Larnaca and Paphos airports serve around 165 destinations in 42 countries, most of them from Larnaca.
flightsCyprusPage.lcaP2: We book from both airports and advise which offers the best routing, timing, and price for your specific journey.

flightsCyprusPage.groupP2: We negotiate directly with airlines for group allocations, manage name changes and additions, and provide a single point of contact for the entire group.

flightsCyprusPage.faq1Q: Is it cheaper to book through a travel agent than online?
flightsCyprusPage.faq1A: Sometimes. As an IATA agent we can book airline fares including some corporate and agent fares, and we compare them with what is available online. Low-cost airline prices are usually the same as booking direct. The main advantages of booking with us are expert routing, one point of contact for changes, and support if something goes wrong.
flightsCyprusPage.faq2Q: Can you book flights from both Paphos and Larnaca airports?
flightsCyprusPage.faq2A: Yes. We book from both PFO and LCA and advise which airport offers the best routing and pricing for your specific destination and dates.
flightsCyprusPage.faq3Q: What happens if my flight is cancelled?
flightsCyprusPage.faq3A: We proactively monitor all active bookings. When disruptions occur, we begin rebooking immediately — often before you're even aware of the cancellation. Reach us 24/7 via WhatsApp.
flightsCyprusPage.faq4Q: Do you offer corporate flight accounts?
flightsCyprusPage.faq4A: Yes. Corporate clients receive a dedicated account manager, monthly consolidated invoicing, corporate fares where airlines offer them, and priority rebooking during disruptions.
flightsCyprusPage.faq5Q: How far in advance should I book flights from Cyprus?
flightsCyprusPage.faq5A: For the best fares, we recommend booking 2-3 months ahead for European routes and 3-6 months for long-haul destinations. However, we often find last-minute deals for flexible travellers.

privatePage.heroSubtitle: Principal-led travel management for private clients, families and family offices — from scheduled first class to private aviation, yachts and everything around them. Based in Cyprus. Available worldwide.
privatePage.discretionIntro: Before itineraries, before aircraft, before hotels — confidentiality. Our private client practice is built on three commitments:
privatePage.pillar1Body: Non-disclosure agreements are available as a standard part of engagement. We never publish client names, destinations or arrangements — no testimonials, no case studies with identities, no social media.
privatePage.pillar2Body: Travel details are shared strictly on a need-to-know basis — with airlines, operators and hotels receiving only what is required to deliver the service, and nothing more.
privatePage.pillar3Body: Personal data, passport and payment information are processed under GDPR, retained only as long as necessary, and never shared with third parties for marketing.
privatePage.principalTitle: One principal. One line. One relationship.
privatePage.principalBody1: Private client accounts at JetSet are not routed through a call centre or a rotating team. Every engagement is handled personally by Nontari Kalaitsidis, co-founder and principal of JetSet, an IATA-accredited agency (IATA 14200130) based in Paphos. Nontari works in English, Greek and Russian.
privatePage.principalBody2: You and your office deal with one person who knows your preferences, your family, your aircraft seating, your dietary notes and your definition of urgent. Out-of-hours, the same person answers.

privatePage.scope2Desc: First and business class on commercial airlines, complex multi-city routings, last-minute changes handled end to end.
privatePage.scope3Desc: Crewed motor and sailing yachts in the Mediterranean and beyond, with provisioning and berth coordination.
privatePage.scope4Desc: Meet-and-assist at Larnaca and Paphos, and the Express Lane fast-track at Larnaca. At airports abroad we check which VIP services exist and book them where offered.
privatePage.scope7Desc: Restaurant tables, private events and performances, booked for you.
privatePage.scope8Desc: Discreet logistics around treatment abroad: flights, accommodation for accompanying family, ground arrangements.
privatePage.scope9Desc: Multi-generational family trips, travelling staff, nannies, tutors and crew — managed under the same account, to the same standard.
privatePage.scope10Desc: Visa support, parental travel consent letters prepared ready for notarisation, and travel documentation prepared correctly the first time.
